history.name: A printed edition for the client
history.description: Each release can be printed as a single self-contained document for the client: a covered, typeset catalogue of everything the product does, laid out area by area with each feature named, sized and described in plain language. It is a real designed document rather than a dump of the record — the thing that gets attached to an email or handed over at a presentation — and one is minted per release, so the client accumulates a shelf of editions rather than a file that keeps changing under them.
history.dev_notes: src/render/ledger-html.mjs renders real HTML/CSS; src/render/pdf.mjs prints it through headless Chromium with printBackground on, exactly as a person would print a styled page.
